messages:
amira: quick check - PR 521 touched the structured output examples. spotted two minor but important things: the example response envelope shows `metadata` as optional but tests expect it present; and the go SDK snippet path is wrong.
ryan: thanks, which file?
amira: /docs/tooling/envelopes.md, example block starting line ~42. current block: 
```json
{
  "envelope": {
    "action": "create"
  }
}
```
pat: missing metadata there, should be present to match the validator used by the runtime. suggest adding an empty object default in the example so it mirrors real responses.
ci-bot: docs linkcheck failed: anchor 'sdk-go/examples' missing in /docs/tooling/envelopes.md (see https://ci.internal/links/521).
nina: i'll update the example to include metadata: {} and fix the go path to `sdk/go/tool_call.go`.
ryan: can we also add a 1-line comment in the example explaining why metadata is returned (tracing + routing hints)? short sentence under the code block is fine.
amira: yes, that will help readers. pat: also add a tiny note in the migration guide referencing this envelope requirement so integrators don't get surprises.
ci-bot: PR opened by nina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521 (envelope example fix, go snippet path, migration note).
nina: opened, tagging amira for review.
amira: reviewing now. if green i'll merge before EOD.
ryan: thanks team, this will reduce the number of runtime mismatch tickets we've been triaging.
